name: USB Hub Support
author: NachoCasta
summary: Experimental candidate: hub continuity across Link mode changes.
description: Candidate awaiting full validation: retain local hub sources across PRO DJ LINK On/Off changes. Four local decks with Link off; two with external Link on. Hub libraries stay local and use independent servers/caches. Short-press USB STOP to select a stick; hold to eject the hub. Wait for safe-to-remove confirmation. Exact firmware2.00 only. Actual-CDJ, phase-sync, eight-source hardware and long-session use remain unvalidated.
